meta.title: Codex monitor
meta.description: Watch the Codex desktop app from the sidebar: which sessions are running, what each one is doing, and which one is waiting for your answer. Send work into any session without switching windows.

page.title: Codex monitor
page.empty: No Codex sessions found. Check that ~/.codex exists and the desktop app has run at least once.
page.pythonMissing: python3 was not found on this machine. Set CODEX_MONITOR_PYTHON to its path and reload the plugin.

reply.placeholder: Message to send into this Codex session…
reply.sent: Delivered. Codex will pick it up shortly.
reply.queuedNote: Codex appends this as a new turn; it does not interrupt work already running.
